That's important because we're watching a shift happen in real time. The biggest trend we're tracking right now is the rise of AI agents and autonomous workflows. The conversation used to be about AI assistants helping humans work faster. Now it's becoming AI systems coordinating entire workflows with minimal human intervention. The companies that understand that shift early are going to have a massive advantage. And that's exactly what we're building toward. So let's get into what happened overnight.
